prompt:
Write the file `measures.dax` for the repository "kpi-semantic-model".

Stack: Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, Excel
Purpose of this file: DAX measures for sales, margin, year-over-year and rolling 12 months
Project context: One Power BI report on a star-schema model replacing 14 separate Excel sales reports.

Requirements:
- 25 to 70 lines of realistic, plausible code in the right language for the file extension.
- A few short comments, no long docstrings, no secrets or real credentials.
- Output only the file contents, without Markdown fences.
text:
Total Sales = SUM ( Sales[SalesAmount] )

Total Cost = SUM ( Sales[CostAmount] )

Gross Margin = [Total Sales] - [Total Cost]

Gross Margin % = DIVIDE ( [Gross Margin], [Total Sales] )

Sales LY =
CALCULATE (
    [Total Sales],
    SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] )
)

Gross Margin LY =
CALCULATE (
    [Gross Margin],
    SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] )
)

Sales YoY =
[Total Sales] - [Sales LY]

Sales YoY % =
DIVIDE ( [Sales YoY], [Sales LY] )

Gross Margin YoY =
[Gross Margin] - [Gross Margin LY]

Gross Margin YoY % =
DIVIDE ( [Gross Margin YoY], [Gross Margin LY] )

Sales Rolling 12M =
CALCULATE (
    [Total Sales],
    DATESINPERIOD ( 'Date'[Date], MAX ( 'Date'[Date] ), -12, MONTH )
)

Gross Margin Rolling 12M =
CALCULATE (
    [Gross Margin],
    DATESINPERIOD ( 'Date'[Date], MAX ( 'Date'[Date] ), -12, MONTH )
)

Sales Rolling 12M LY =
CALCULATE (
    [Total Sales],
    DATESINPERIOD ( DATEADD ( 'Date'[Date], -12, MONTH ), MAX ( 'Date'[Date] ), -12, MONTH )
)

-- Use calendar context for prior year comparisons
Sales YTD =
TOTALYTD ( [Total Sales], 'Date'[Date] )

Gross Margin YTD =
TOTALYTD ( [Gross Margin], 'Date'[Date] )

Sales YTD LY =
CALCULATE (
    [Sales YTD],
    SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] )
)

Gross Margin YTD LY =
CALCULATE (
    [Gross Margin YTD],
    SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] )
)

Sales R12M YoY =
[Sales Rolling 12M] - CALCULATE ( [Sales Rolling 12M], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ) )

Sales R12M YoY % =
DIVIDE (
    [Sales R12M YoY],
    CALCULATE ( [Sales Rolling 12M], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ) )
)
